items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: That was her husband. George, yeah.

ctx.x: Is that for you? Okay, it's all in the end.

All right. Then I, for my season, 1918, I began that season with the Cole Brothers Circus under the directorship of J.C. Myers, the husband of Lizzie Myers. Contrary to what another publisher said about he being the father, that's not true. That was her husband. George, yeah. And, uh, that's right. And J.C. Myers' minstrel shows on the Cole Brothers Circus was a unit similar to the Georgia Smart Set, the Alabama minstrels, and the Virginia minstrels. The man owned all of those shows. In fact, the Cole Brothers…
I think I've seen the Cole Brothers Circus from the last year.
